claims.text: scripts/up.sh runs scripts/dev-secrets.sh, builds the Flutter app (flutter build web), starts the lab with docker compose up -d --build --wait, then prints the addresses.

DonHang.Api/Dockerfile builds with the .NET 10 SDK (sdk:10.0), runs on the .NET 10 ASP.NET Core runtime (aspnet:10.0), and installs libgssapi-krb5-2 because Npgsql probes for Kerberos/GSSAPI at startup; without it a harmless 'cannot open shared object' line is logged.
docker-compose.yml gives the API its connection string and JWT signing key as environment variables.
Nothing in the API's own code mentions libgssapi-krb5-2; it is needed only by the database library.
